summary: Iteration 4: Tested NEW user management CRUD + configurable tax rate. Backend: 14/14 new pytest in test_iter4_users_settings.py PASS (full suite 59/59). Frontend Playwright: admin login, Settings page with Users + Tax tabs, add/edit/delete user, role change, self-delete blocked with 'Cannot delete yourself' toast, tax rate updated 8→12 and POS dynamically reflects 'Tax (12%)', cashier login redirects to /pos and Settings nav is hidden. All acceptance criteria pass.

minor.issue: Allows changing the only admin's role to 'cashier' which can lock out admin access. Consider preventing role-downgrade of last remaining admin.
No password length / strength validation. Empty role string accepted (defaults handled by Pydantic default only when key missing).
tax_rate accepts negative values and >100 at backend (frontend validates 0-100, but server should also validate to harden API).

issues: No pagination/search; with many cashiers the list grows unbounded (12 visible already). Consider search-by-email or pagination.
Delete button on the current admin row should be disabled client-side (currently relies on backend 400 toast). Minor UX polish.

action_items: (Optional) Add server-side validation for tax_rate range (0-100) and password min length on user create/update.
(Optional UX) Disable delete icon on the currently-logged-in admin row to avoid relying on backend rejection.
(Optional) Prevent demoting/deleting the last remaining admin account.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:update_user — correctly uses ObjectId(user_id); password change re-hashes only when non-empty (good). Returns sanitised user without password_hash.
server.py:delete_user — compares current['_id'] (string after get_current_user) with user_id; works because get_current_user converts _id to string. Self-delete protection is correct.
server.py:get_settings — does NOT require admin (correct: cashier POS needs to read tax_rate); update_settings is admin-only (correct).
SettingsPage.js — uses withCredentials; tax input clamped 0-100 client-side; toast feedback on save. Good.
POSPage.js — fetches tax_rate from /api/settings on mount and renders 'Tax ({taxRate}%)' dynamically. Verified visually in browser.
Sidebar.js — Settings nav gated by roles=['admin'] only; verified cashier cannot see it.
App.js — /settings route protected by allowedRoles=['admin']; non-admin redirected to /pos.
Edit User dialog disables email input (good — prevents email change which would orphan login).
No data-testid on confirm-dialog for delete (uses window.confirm); fine for now but a custom modal would be more testable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (admin Settings CRUD, tax update→POS reflection, cashier role gating)

seed_data_creation: All TEST_* users and the temporary cashier (TEST_cui_*) created during UI run were deleted after testing. Tax rate was set to 12 then restored to 8 (current user-set value).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` (59 tests total, ~10s, all pass). Iter4 tests in test_iter4_users_settings.py cover users CRUD + settings tax_rate + role authz. Frontend critical selectors for settings: settings-page, tab-users, tab-tax, add-user-btn, user-row-{id}, edit-user-{id}, delete-user-{id}, user-name-input, user-email-input, user-password-input, user-role-select, save-user-btn, tax-rate-input, save-tax-btn. Sidebar: nav-settings (admin only), nav-pos---sales. POS displays dynamic 'Tax ({taxRate}%)'. Cashier accounts redirect to /pos on login and cannot see Settings nav. Delete confirmation uses window.confirm — Playwright must register a dialog handler with page.on('dialog', d.accept).
rca of the issue: No new bugs found. Initial test failure was a test-side bug (case-sensitivity in email comparison since backend lowercases emails on store) — fixed by lowercasing the test email before comparison. The backend correctly normalises emails to lowercase on both register and create_user paths.
